brief: Review the open defect register for outstanding work orders to re-prioritise items against the unit's ability to shed heat before the event begins, prioritizing categories 1 to 3 for completion wherever crew capacity allows [SOP-016]. For any ageing unit with a history of high loading that cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period [MG-021].
